summary: Extract JL 18.7.7 from the translation into refs
before: They approached me and said: “Testify” – I replied: “What should I testify? What should I say?” – They said: “Aren’t you a Muslim?” – I said: “No” JL 18.7.7;
after: They approached me and said: “Testify” – I replied: “What should I testify? What should I say?” – They said: “Aren’t you a Muslim?” – I said: “No”
rationale: The reference has been swallowed by the translation and refs is empty. JL 18.7/7 contains the quoted exchange, including the answer No, so the reference can be moved to refs without changing the translated wording.
